value.rationale: The result analyzes a natural operational invariant of a sliding rank/median filter: whether an output changes after refreshing one observation. It supplies exact dependence at adjacent and full-window-separated refreshes, an unexpected median independence boundary, and an exact off-center rank optimizer. These answer interpretable questions about refresh counts and streaking dependence rather than arbitrary numeric special cases.
